thesis: BioMarin (Nasdaq: BMRN). Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-11-03) read in part (first 100,000 of 101,886 characters; legal and MD&A truncated). Q3 revenue 1,024.6M vs 776.1M (+32%); 9M 2,780.6M vs 2,346.7M (+18.5%), driven by Amicus (closed 2026-04-27, consideration 5,323.6M; contributed 336.4M revenue and a 239.4M net loss since closing; Galafold 151.8M, Pombiliti and Opfolda 48.6M in Q3). Legacy lines: Voxzogo +12.2% to 245.0M, Vimizim +18.1%, Naglazyme -11.6%, Palynziq +2.1%, Roctavian 0.7M. Q3 GAAP net loss 122.8M including 287.7M acquired IPR&D (Alesta, closed 2026-08-31, 303.4M); 9M NI 27.5M vs 395.5M. TTM (USD): revenue 3,655.1M, NI -19.1M, OCF 676.6M, capex 118.8M, FCF 557.8M, SBC 219.6M (FCF after SBC 338.2M). Close 61.43 (2026-11-18, +5.0% that day) x 193,694,734 shares (cover 2026-10-26) = 11.90B market cap; FCF yield 4.7% (2.8% after SBC). Debt principal 4,235M (Term Loan A 790M due 2031, Term Loan B 1,995M due 2033, 5.5% notes 850M due 2034, 600M convertible due May 2027 classed current) vs cash 736.0M: net debt about 3.5B, EV about 15.4B = 4.2x TTM revenue. The price implies integration of Amicus succeeds and Voxzogo and Galafold hold up; what differs from that view is not yet shown; mispricing is not established.
counterthesis: GAAP earnings are near zero and 9M effective tax rate was 61.2%; net debt rose from net cash to about 3.5B in one year, so interest cost will weigh on cash flow (not quantified) and the 600M convertible comes due May 2027; OCF 9M fell to 577.0M from 728.4M. Voxzogo faces competition risk (unverified in text read), Naglazyme is shrinking, Roctavian is negligible, and acquired IPR&D charges recur with each deal. FCF excludes acquisitions that management keeps making. SBC about 220M TTM is large.
invalidation: Invalidated if Voxzogo growth stalls or loses share, Amicus products decline, interest and amortization consume FCF, or leverage rises through more acquisitions without cash flow growth.
